verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management product, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. The pack never shows the product's source published under an open license. The only GitHub reference is a separate MCP server repo, with no license stated, and that is an adjacent component rather than the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
